title: Uniqueness of unit-times-integer-power factorization
statement: For a domain DVR [lem-weil-pbc-dvr-unit-times-uniformizer-power] and a generator \pi of its nonzero maximal ideal, the unit and integer exponent in a fraction-field expression x = u \pi^m are unique.

proof.text: Install the DVR and fraction-ring instances. A generator of the maximal ideal is irreducible. Apply the source-library valuation lemma Ring.ordOf_units_eq to each displayed factorization, obtaining equality of the integer exponents. After substituting the common exponent, cancel the nonzero power of the generator in the field and use extensionality of units to identify the unit factors.

lean.statement: theorem extension_integers_dvr_factorization_unique (E : Type*) [Field E] (O : Subring E) (m : Ideal O) (hDVR : IsDiscreteValuationRing O) (hmax : m.IsMaximal) (hfrac : IsFractionRing O E) : ∀ π : O, Ideal.span ({π} : Set O) = m → ∀ x : Eˣ, ∀ p q : Oˣ × ℤ, (x : E) = ((p.1 : O) : E) * (π : E) ^ p.2 → (x : E) = ((q.1 : O) : E) * (π : E) ^ q.2 → p = q
